Question:
For veg whsle data, can you analyze our financial performance over the years 2020 to 2023? I need insights into the average wholesale price, maximum wholesale price, minimum wholesale price, wholesale price difference, total wholesale price, total selling price, average loss rate, total loss, and profit for each category within each year. Round all calculated values to two decimal places.

4 candidates were produced independently. Each shows its SQL and the first rows of its result.

SQL:
SELECT 
    w.category_name,
    w.year,
    ROUND(w.avg_wholesale_price, 2) as avg_wholesale_price,
    ROUND(w.max_wholesale_price, 2) as max_wholesale_price,
    ROUND(w.min_wholesale_price, 2) as min_wholesale_price,
    ROUND(w.wholesale_price_difference, 2) as wholesale_price_difference,
    ROUND(w.total_wholesale_price, 2) as total_wholesale_price,
    ROUND(t.total_selling_price, 2) as total_selling_price,
    ROUND(t.avg_loss_rate, 2) as avg_loss_rate,
    ROUND(t.total_loss, 2) as total_loss,
    ROUND(t.profit, 2) as profit
FROM (
    SELECT 
        vc.category_name,
        year(CAST(w.whsle_date AS DATE)) as year,
        AVG(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg") as avg_wholesale_price,
        MAX(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg") as max_wholesale_price,
        MIN(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg") as min_wholesale_price,
        MAX(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg") - MIN(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg") as wholesale_price_difference,
        SUM(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg") as total_wholesale_price
    FROM veg_whsle_df w
    JOIN veg_cat vc ON w.item_code = vc.item_code
    WHERE year(CAST(w.whsle_date AS DATE)) IN (2020, 2021, 2022, 2023)
    GROUP BY vc.category_name, year(CAST(w.whsle_date AS DATE))
) w
JOIN (
    SELECT 
        vc.category_name,
        year(CAST(t.txn_date AS DATE)) as year,
        SUM(t."qty_sold(kg)" * t."unit_selling_px_rmb/kg") as total_selling_price,
        AVG(l."loss_rate_%" / 100.0) as avg_loss_rate,
        SUM(t."qty_sold(kg)" * t."unit_selling_px_rmb/kg" * l."loss_rate_%" / 100.0) as total_loss,

WITH wholesale_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        c.category_name,
        TRY_CAST(SUBSTR(w.whsle_date, 1, 4) AS BIGINT) as year,
        AVG(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg") as avg_wholesale_price,
        MAX(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg") as max_wholesale_price,
        MIN(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg") as min_wholesale_price,
        MAX(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg") - MIN(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg") as wholesale_price_diff,
        SUM(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg") as total_wholesale_price,
        AVG(l."loss_rate_%") as avg_loss_rate
    FROM veg_whsle_df w
    JOIN veg_cat c ON w.item_code = c.item_code
    LEFT JOIN veg_loss_rate_df l ON w.item_code = l.item_code
    WHERE TRY_CAST(SUBSTR(w.whsle_date, 1, 4) AS BIGINT) BETWEEN 2020 AND 2023
    GROUP BY c.category_name, TRY_CAST(SUBSTR(w.whsle_date, 1, 4) AS BIGINT)
),
selling_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        c.category_name,
        TRY_CAST(SUBSTR(t.txn_date, 1, 4) AS BIGINT) as year,
        SUM(t."qty_sold(kg)" * t."unit_selling_px_rmb/kg") as total_selling_price
    FROM veg_txn_df t
    JOIN veg_cat c ON t.item_code = c.item_code
    WHERE t."sale/return" = 'sale'
      AND TRY_CAST(SUBSTR(t.txn_date, 1, 4) AS BIGINT) BETWEEN 2020 AND 2023
    GROUP BY c.category_name, TRY_CAST(SUBSTR(t.txn_date, 1, 4) AS BIGINT)
),
avg_loss_by_category AS (
    SELECT 
        c.category_name,
        AVG(l."loss_rate_%") as avg_loss_rate
    FROM veg_loss_rate_df l
    JOIN veg_cat c ON l.item_code = c.item_code
    GROUP BY c.category_name
)
